m.tour.welcome_text: A short tour (about a minute) shows the most important places. Use the arrow keys to move, Esc ends the tour.
m.tour.home_text: Here you see the inbox, recently added documents and your views. Use “Customize” to choose the widgets yourself.
m.tour.upload_text: Click here or simply drag files anywhere into the window. PaperRust reads the text and sorts them automatically.
m.tour.inbox_text: New documents land here. Check title and assignments, then tick them off with “Done”.
m.tour.filter_text: Type a term or pick tags, correspondent, type and date. With “Ask”, PaperRust answers questions about your archive when AI is enabled.
m.tour.list_text: A click opens the document next to the list. Use the checkboxes to select several and edit them together, including PDF tools. Keys j/k switch documents.
m.tour.views_text: Frequently used filters appear here as entries of their own, with the number of matching documents.
m.tour.search_text: Press Ctrl+K anywhere to find documents, tags, pages and commands.
m.tour.manage_text: Tags, correspondents, document types, storage paths, workflows, mail fetching and more – grouped into “Organize” and “System”.
m.tour.settings_text: Language, appearance, density, notifications and your profile with password, two-factor login and API token.
m.tour.user_text: Light or dark, profile, documentation, keyboard shortcuts, switching to the classic interface – and this tour to start again.
m.tour.outro_text: That was the tour. More is in the documentation in the user menu. PaperRust is free software – thanks to everyone who contributes.

m.ai_settings.prompt_vision_hint: Instruction for the image model per page.
m.ai_settings.prompts_hint: Adjust what the AI is told for each task. Built-in templates work well; change them only if needed.
m.ai_settings.title: Artificial intelligence (AI)
m.ai_settings.trigger_tag_hint: Documents with this tag are processed by the AI every few minutes. Empty = off.
m.ai_settings.use_ai_hint: Optional. Off by default. Everything else on this page only works when this is on.
m.ai_settings.vision_hint: An image model reads difficult scans and handwriting. Slower and, with online services, more expensive than normal text recognition.
m.ai_settings.vision_model_hint: For example qwen2.5vl, minicpm-v or llava (Ollama), gpt-4o-mini (OpenAI). Empty = text model.
m.ai_settings.vision_per_day: Pages per day at most (0 = no limit)
m.ai_settings.vision_tokens: AI text recognition: tokens per page at most (0 = provider default)
m.ai_settings.vision_when_difficult: documents where normal recognition finds little text (recommended)
m.ai_settings.vision_when_off: only when chosen for a document
m.ai_settings.workflow_hint: In workflows you can also use the action “Apply AI suggestions”.
